description: This file provides a Django-compatible HTTP streaming interface to deliver weather forecast data asynchronously via newline-delimited JSON. It includes a function serve_weather_stream that yields JSON chunks representing headers, updates, and trailer for streaming weather information.

methods.name: Iterable[bytes] serve_weather_stream(city: Optional[str], units: str = "metric", delay_seconds: float = 0.35)
methods.description: Generates a stream of NDJSON bytes representing weather updates for a specified city, with optional delay between chunks.

ctags.name: serve_weather_stream
ctags.pattern: /^def serve_weather_stream(city: Optional[str], units: str = "metric", delay_seconds: float = 0.35/
